text:
jess: Ran a focused microbenchmark this morning across L40S / A100 / H100 comparing fused-paged Flash variants + our 'adaptive-kv-evict' heuristic. Posting highlights and a repro so we can discuss next steps.

sam: nice, quick summary?

jess: tl;dr: fused-paged variant wins for bsz>=8 and seq<=1024. For bsz<=2 + long seq (>=4096) we see large tail latency spikes on L40S where KV cache eviction oscillates. Not seen on A100. H100 has intermediate behavior.

lee: can you paste the exact command and the minimal env?

jess: sure:
```bash
./bench_attention --model=llama-7b-8bit \n  --kernel=fused-paged-adaptive \n  --gpus=L40S,A100,H100 \n  --seqs=128,512,1024,2048,4096 \n  --bszs=1,2,4,8,16 \n  --kv-policy=adaptive-evict --warmup=50 --iter=200
```

perf-bot: benchmark run started (id=bench-2825-03). Logs streaming to s3://redwood-perf/bench-2825-03/

jess: attaching condensed results snippet (median latency in ms per token):

```
gpu,bsz,seq,variant,median_ms_per_token
L40S,1,4096,fused-paged-adaptive,12.8
L40S,1,2048,fused-paged-adaptive,5.6
L40S,8,1024,fused-paged-adaptive,1.2
A100,1,4096,fused-paged-adaptive,4.1
H100,1,4096,fused-paged-adaptive,6.5
A100,8,1024,fused-paged-adaptive,1.1
L40S,1,4096,paged-only,9.9
A100,1,4096,paged-only,4.3
H100,1,4096,paged-only,6.1
```

sam: whoa L40S 12.8 ms/token at bsz1 seq4k. That's a big regression vs paged-only. Do we have traces?

jess: yes, attaching a lightweight trace excerpt - kernel selection flips between fused and paged every ~60ms, KV evictor runs concurrently. Observed pattern: when fused wins for short windows it allocs bigger working set, then evictor tries to reclaim -> mid-request spill -> latency spike.

lee: any config flags that changed recently for 'adaptive-evict'?

jess: tested two configs: default (target_unused_ratio=0.15,evict_interval=50ms) and conservative (target_unused_ratio=0.25,evict_interval=150ms). Conservative cuts spikes ~35% on L40S but increases avg mem pressure on A100.

infra-bot: alert: node l40s-12 reported GPU memory fragmentation > 78% during bench-2825-03 at 10:12:43 UTC

sam: hypothesis: L40S driver/allocator + fused kernel transient working set -> more fragmentation -> evictor thrashes. Could also be hw prefetch differences.

jess: next steps I propose: 1) run allocator-level defrag (mimalloc reset) before bench on L40S; 2) instrument per-request mem-alloc delta; 3) run with quantized kernels (int8) to see working set shrink impact.

lee: also useful to run single-step without adaptive switch: force kernel=fused-paged-fixed to remove selection jitter. If spikes disappear, it's selection glue.

perf-bot: created perf ticket PERF-617: "L40S fused-paged evict oscillation at low bsz, long seq" and attached bench artifacts.

jess: I'll run the fixed-kernel run and the defrag round this afternoon and post updated CSV. If someone wants to grab a repro GPU for deep profiler, l40s-12 is still warm.

sam: thanks. If you get a stable repro, I can run kmem trace and check eviction primitives.

jess: awesome — will ping when results posted. :muscle:
